title: Eyewear Designer
note: On-site eyewear design role at a New Orleans eyewear brand; eyewear design experience from school or an internship counts, with about four NYC trips a year.

facts.summary: Designer on KREWE's eyewear product team, reporting to the VP of Product Design and supporting collections from concept to production.
facts.duties: Trend, color and materials research; seasonal palettes and concepts; sketches, renderings, specs and presentations; working with product development, sourcing and vendors; keeping samples, documents and timelines organized.
facts.requirements: Eyewear design experience via education, internship or work; organized and detail-oriented; comfortable trying on frames for fit; able to travel to NYC about 4 times a year. No years-of-experience minimum stated.
facts.apply: Apply now button on the Rippling posting.
